request_user:
Fact: additional_assets
What to find: Other assets released with the model (training data, training code, inference or evaluation code, checkpoints) and how to access them.
Card sections that often contain it: Model Sources, Resources, Links

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Pretraining datasets are available in a Hugging Face collection (mid-training and post-training datasets to be uploaded later); training and evaluation configs and code are in the huggingface/smollm GitHub repository; intermediate training checkpoints (including mid-training and SFT checkpoints) are at HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-checkpoints; quantized checkpoints are in a Hugging Face collection.
quotes: The datasets used for pretraining can be found in this [collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/HuggingFaceTB/smollm3-pretraining-datasets-685a7353fdc01aecde51b1d9) and those used in mid-training and post-training will be uploaded later
The training and evaluation configs and code can be found in the [huggingface/smollm](https://github.com/huggingface/smollm) repository.

The training intermediate checkpoints (including the mid-training and SFT checkpoints) are available at [HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-checkpoints](https://huggingface.co/HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B-checkpoints)
You can find quantized checkpoints in this collection (https://huggingface.co/collections/HuggingFaceTB/smollm3-686d33c1fdffe8e635317e23)
